adjudication.rationale: The diff itself acknowledges the stale-input issue: `addMembers` has `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not clear `this.usernames` after a successful add (admin-group.js.es6 `actions.addMembers`). Also both `addMembers` and `removeMember` fire async requests (`model.addMembers(...)`, `model.removeMember(...)`) without any `.then/.catch` handling or returned promise from the action (addMembers doesn’t `return`), so a server-side failure (e.g., 422 from `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`/`#remove_member` for automatic groups) would not surface any UI feedback in this code. This is a concrete, diff-grounded UX/robustness gap rather than a guaranteed functional break.
